purpose: Source-mapped elaboration of harness-first adoption and the bounded non-QL native cut inside O-I#65. No new user-story IDs, installer schema, runtime or evidence store.
standing: owner-directed intended-experience clarification, 2026-09-19; implementation and installed proof remain separate

adoption65.policy: Read the complete source, current INSTALL-UPDATE-FLOW and native admission/ground contracts. This elaborates existing stories; no source count, merge or available Skill establishes actual use.

obligations.requirement: Enter through an ordinary request in an existing harness; explain and select useful participation before native mutation, without requiring a preinstalled O:I context or a replacement application.
required_branches: Cold bootstrap and already-compatible installations are exercised separately; no hidden developer checkout, local daemon or toolchain is assumed.
0/1/2 is the proposed Central/Actuation/AIKit operational participation, not a compulsory menu; the user can retain native tools or select less.
Engagement facets do not rename native frame/wire identities or historical receipts; hosted 5/0 requires no visitor-side product installation.
A text-only or otherwise execution-limited harness names the actual local step; a pasted request is not installation evidence.
The accepted bounded plan explains prerequisites, locations, scope and effects and preserves meaningful cancellation or refusal.

obligations.requirement: Use native Central root/Project recognition, binding and deliberate migration while retaining human source, existing agents, Skills, exclusions and pending work.
required_branches: Root meta-Project and child Project work both have valid entry; no fake child or compulsory source relocation.
Plan/readback distinguishes in-place binding, optional move, agent-source reconciliation and derived harness projection.
Conflicting custom files, duplicate native identities, stale source and interrupted/repeated migration preserve originals and useful state.
Native Skills/agents are explained before admission; presence alone neither changes authorship nor grants trust/authority.

obligations.requirement: Make actual source-owned Skills, Methods and default Guardian relations understandable, discoverable, selected and useful in the chosen scope.
required_branches: Current O:I bootstrap manifest governs membership; do not resurrect the retired frozen Central strap or a foreign-skill registry.
Central-owned strap source arrives through the native AIKit ground binding; actual source/projection/loading/use are recorded distinctly.
A SkillSet is not an AgentSet; use real Guardian source/default identities and explain purpose and scope without auto-running all agents.
Methods remain Skills whose description begins METHOD:; test relevant trigger and near-miss, not only presence of a file.
A fresh actor performs a useful task with the selected source/practice without being given the verifier's expected answer.

obligations.requirement: Project through the actual harness adapter, install compatible scoped hooks, and complete truthful live/next-session/restart activation with a recoverable first task.
required_branches: Edition/version and native faculties are independently observed; a shared brand name supplies no unsupported parity.
Hook purpose, trigger, source, ordering, scope, limits, failure and owned retraction are inspectable; repeats do not duplicate or recursively strap callbacks.
Written projection, hook registration, activation and effective use have independent evidence; missing hot reload produces an exact pending-restart explanation.
Restart/resume preserves task/source identity where supported and names explicit successor/reconstituted context where not; unrelated sessions remain alive.
Foreign settings and user edits survive update/retraction; no auto-inference on passive source change or wholesale private transcript telemetry.

obligations.requirement: Make externally entered harness work and O:I-started SessionSpaces converge through real native context, model, authority and Activity relations, adding Factory ancestry only for genuinely commissioned work.
required_branches: External retain/adopt and native start are separately exercised; failed adoption does not launch a duplicate or fabricate prior stream history.
Requested/resolved/observed model, provider, credential horizon and allowed fallback are distinct; tests observe the real recipient and response.
Two scoped sessions, duplicate/out-of-order events, cancellation and reconnect do not cross-wire prompts, models, context or results.
Direct/native sessions remain valid without Factory; Commission/Run/attempt/stream/result/independent Return must actually join when selected.
Day/NOW and effective historical context use current native owners; closing a surface or replacing installed binaries does not silently cancel or migrate work.
New-UI consumers receive the existing operations and exact failure/recovery states; a donor-app pass is not destination-UI proof.

obligations.requirement: An unsupported or partial harness yields a useful SDK/conformance route; acceptance, refusal and eventual retraction preserve the person's existing world.
required_branches: Report actual target/version/faculties, owner SDK/Skill, required conformance and current useful limitations.
Author/register an adapter only under its own bounded authority, then repeat admission and the original useful operation.
SDK fixtures retain their scope; fake-target conformance is not support for a real untested harness.
Denied authority, conflicting configuration, deferred restart and unsupported hooks have meaningful continuation; removal only retracts owned material.

obligations.requirement: Converge and install the explicitly selected current non-QL native cut on the Mac using the existing managed update authority, with exact held QL/app and actual running-provider disclosure.
required_branches: Account for remote and both-machine accepted/unique work without resetting active checkouts or reinstalling personal ground.
Select current committed source cuts before invoking the updater; native source archive/build/content-addressed activation/receipt is not a historical release or hand-copy install.
The allow-list and rollback/receipt consequences preserve held QL artifacts, registration and current app generation; no unscoped all-product mutation.
Declared companions/resources and PATH plus GUI/headless resolution are verified; installed and resident running generations are separately observed.
A frozen consumer incompatibility has a precise native owner and qualification; it does not authorise changing QL or wholesale-merging active Cradle work.

obligations.requirement: Run source-grounded useful-work tests in existing feature worktrees and isolated Omarchy test worlds; preserve failures, repair native owners and independently replay without duplicating the campaign or frontend.
required_branches: Code worktree per coherent feature/development line, not per agent/session/retry; file claims and Git mutations are coordinated.
Separate sandbox/test-state allocation from code-worktree creation; preserve host and Mac/frontend work and retain evidence outside guest deletion.
Adoption, session/Factory and lifecycle lanes may use disjoint resources concurrently after binding the exact tested cut; shared host services and desktop focus are serialized.
Use original and held-out tasks and test the verifier against disconnected operations or stale/unloaded sources; do not weaken expectations for a green result.
Consume demonstrated Day/NOW readiness where needed; preserve excluded QL/full-UI scope and no premature human-ratification gate.

current_cut_scope.selector_policy: Validate current updater help and actual plan against this explicit scope; do not assume aliases or apply an unscoped rollback.
